sentences.en: I always shop around before I buy something expensive.
sentences.de: Ich vergleiche immer die Preise in mehreren Geschäften, bevor ich etwas Teures kaufe.

sentences.en: Last week I had to return a jumper to the store because it was too small.
sentences.de: Letzte Woche musste ich einen Pullover ins Geschäft zurückbringen, weil er zu klein war.

sentences.en: I have a points card for my favourite supermarket and use my points regularly.
sentences.de: Ich habe eine Punktekarte für meinen Lieblingssupermarkt und nutze meine Punkte regelmäßig.

sentences.en: Many people take advantage of major shopping days like Black Friday.
sentences.de: Viele Leute nutzen große Einkaufstage wie den Black Friday aus.

sentences.en: My dad does most of the grocery shopping in our home because he loves cooking.
sentences.de: Mein Papa erledigt den Großteil des Lebensmitteleinkaufs bei uns zu Hause, weil er das Kochen liebt.

sentences.en: On Saturdays we like to go window shopping in the main shopping street.
sentences.de: Samstags machen wir gerne einen Schaufensterbummel in der Haupteinkaufsstraße.

sentences.en: The bargain shopper hunts for special offers, while the impulse buyer buys things spontaneously.
sentences.de: Der Schnäppchenjäger jagt nach Sonderangeboten, während der Impulskäufer Dinge spontan kauft.

sentences.en: You can buy fresh fish at the fishmonger's and fruit and vegetables at the greengrocer's.
sentences.de: Frischen Fisch kannst du beim Fischhändler kaufen und Obst und Gemüse beim Gemüsehändler.

sentences.en: The florist sells flowers, the optician sells glasses, and the off licence sells alcoholic drinks.
sentences.de: Der Blumenhändler verkauft Blumen, der Optiker verkauft Brillen und die Spirituosenhandlung verkauft alkoholische Getränke.

sentences.en: On my shopping list there are a loaf of bread, some cheese and half a pound of grapes.
sentences.de: Auf meiner Einkaufsliste stehen ein Laib Brot, etwas Käse und ein halbes Pfund Weintrauben.

parts: I saw an
for the new phone on television and decided to buy it.
questions.solutionEn: I saw an advertisement for the new phone on television and decided to buy it.
questions.solutionDe: Ich habe im Fernsehen eine Werbung für das neue Handy gesehen und beschlossen, es zu kaufen.
questions.explain: advertisement = Werbung. Werbung informiert (z. B. über den Preis) – sie packt nichts ein und gibt kein Geld aus.
questions.read: I saw an advertisement for the new phone on television and decided to buy it.

parts: I bought these trainers for only 10 euros — what a
questions.solutionEn: I bought these trainers for only 10 euros — what a bargain!
questions.solutionDe: Ich habe diese Turnschuhe für nur 10 Euro gekauft — was für ein Schnäppchen!
questions.explain: bargain = Schnäppchen. Ein Schnäppchen ist gerade NICHT teuer.
questions.read: I bought these trainers for only 10 euros — what a bargain!

parts: At the checkout, the
scans your items and takes your money.
questions.solutionEn: At the checkout, the cashier scans your items and takes your money.
questions.solutionDe: An der Kassa scannt der Kassier deine Artikel und nimmt dein Geld entgegen.
questions.explain: cashier = Kassier/Kassiererin. An der Kassa nimmt er/sie dein Geld entgegen.
questions.read: At the checkout, the cashier scans your items and takes your money.

parts: The book cost 5.99 euros and I paid with a 10-euro note, so I got some
back.
questions.solutionEn: The book cost 5.99 euros and I paid with a 10-euro note, so I got some change back.
questions.solutionDe: Das Buch kostete 5,99 Euro und ich zahlte mit einem 10-Euro-Schein, also bekam ich etwas Wechselgeld zurück.
questions.explain: change = Wechselgeld. Du bekommst 1 Cent zurück. Achtung: change heißt auch 'wechseln/ändern'.
questions.read: The book cost 5.99 euros and I paid with a 10-euro note, so I got some change back.

parts: I had no cash on me, so I paid for the groceries with my
questions.solutionEn: I had no cash on me, so I paid for the groceries with my debit card.
questions.solutionDe: Ich hatte kein Bargeld dabei, also bezahlte ich die Lebensmittel mit meiner Bankomatkarte.
questions.explain: debit card = Bankomatkarte. Damit bezahlt man – also kann man damit etwas kaufen.
questions.read: I had no cash on me, so I paid for the groceries with my debit card.

parts: The shirt was too small, so I took it back to the shop to
it for a bigger size.
questions.solutionEn: The shirt was too small, so I took it back to the shop to exchange it for a bigger size.
questions.solutionDe: Das Hemd war zu klein, also brachte ich es ins Geschäft zurück, um es gegen eine größere Größe umzutauschen.
questions.explain: exchange = umtauschen, also ein Produkt durch ein anderes ersetzen.
questions.read: The shirt was too small, so I took it back to the shop to exchange it for a bigger size.

parts: She took three dresses into the
to try them on.
questions.solutionEn: She took three dresses into the fitting room to try them on.
questions.solutionDe: Sie nahm drei Kleider mit in die Umkleidekabine, um sie anzuprobieren.
questions.explain: fitting room = Umkleidekabine; try on = anprobieren.
questions.read: She took three dresses into the fitting room to try them on.

parts: Please keep the receipt as proof of your
in case you want to return it.
questions.solutionEn: Please keep the receipt as proof of your purchase in case you want to return it.
questions.solutionDe: Bitte heben Sie den Kassenbon als Kaufnachweis auf, falls Sie den Artikel zurückgeben möchten.
questions.explain: purchase = kaufen (formelleres Wort für buy). Als Nomen: a purchase = ein Kauf.
questions.read: Please keep the receipt as proof of your purchase in case you want to return it.

parts: After paying at the till, the cashier gave me a
for my purchase.
questions.solutionEn: After paying at the till, the cashier gave me a receipt for my purchase.
questions.solutionDe: Nach dem Bezahlen an der Kassa gab mir der Kassier eine Quittung für meinen Einkauf.
questions.explain: receipt = Kassenbeleg/Rechnung. Den bekommt man NACH dem Bezahlen.
questions.read: After paying at the till, the cashier gave me a receipt for my purchase.

parts: Security cameras are everywhere because some people try to
and leave the shop without paying.
questions.solutionEn: Security cameras are everywhere because some people try to shoplift and leave the shop without paying.
questions.solutionDe: Überall hängen Überwachungskameras, weil manche Leute versuchen, Ladendiebstahl zu begehen und das Geschäft ohne zu bezahlen zu verlassen.
questions.explain: shoplift = Ladendiebstahl begehen, also etwas aus einem Geschäft stehlen. shoplifter = Ladendieb.
questions.read: Security cameras are everywhere because some people try to shoplift and leave the shop without paying.

parts: At the supermarket I grabbed a
and pushed it down the aisles, filling it with food.
questions.solutionEn: At the supermarket I grabbed a shopping cart and pushed it down the aisles, filling it with food.
questions.solutionDe: Im Supermarkt nahm ich einen Einkaufswagen und schob ihn durch die Gänge, während ich ihn mit Lebensmitteln füllte.
questions.explain: shopping cart = Einkaufswagen (BE: trolley). Man legt seine Waren hinein.
questions.read: At the supermarket I grabbed a shopping cart and pushed it down the aisles, filling it with food.

parts: The shop's
are from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m., so we need to get there before it closes.
questions.solutionEn: The shop's store hours are from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m., so we need to get there before it closes.
questions.solutionDe: Die Öffnungszeiten des Geschäfts sind von 9 bis 18 Uhr, also müssen wir dort sein, bevor es schließt.
questions.explain: store hours = Öffnungszeiten (BE auch: opening hours).
questions.read: The shop's store hours are from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m., so we need to get there before it closes.

parts: At the greengrocer's they put the apples on the scale to check their
before telling me the price.
questions.solutionEn: At the greengrocer's they put the apples on the scale to check their weight before telling me the price.
questions.solutionDe: Beim Obst- und Gemüsehändler legten sie die Äpfel auf die Waage, um ihr Gewicht zu prüfen, bevor sie mir den Preis nannten.
questions.explain: weight = Gewicht. Gramm, Kilogramm und Unzen (ounces) sind alle Gewichtseinheiten.
questions.read: At the greengrocer's they put the apples on the scale to check their weight before telling me the price.

parts: We had no money, so we just went
and looked at the displays in the shop windows.
questions.solutionEn: We had no money, so we just went window shopping and looked at the displays in the shop windows.
questions.solutionDe: Wir hatten kein Geld, also machten wir nur einen Schaufensterbummel und betrachteten die Auslagen in den Schaufenstern.
questions.explain: window shopping = Schaufensterbummel: nur schauen, nichts kaufen.
questions.read: We had no money, so we just went window shopping and looked at the displays in the shop windows.

parts: If you want fresh salmon for dinner, go to the
questions.solutionEn: fishmonger's
questions.solutionDe: Fischhändler / Fischgeschäft
questions.explain: salmon = Lachs → frischen Fisch kauft man beim fishmonger's.
questions.read: If you want fresh salmon for dinner, go to the fishmonger's.

parts: I never buy fruit at the supermarket – I prefer the
around the corner.
questions.solutionEn: greengrocer's
questions.solutionDe: Obst- und Gemüsehändler
questions.explain: greengrocer's = Obst- und Gemüsegeschäft. Merkhilfe: green = Gemüse/Obst.
questions.read: I never buy fruit at the supermarket – I prefer the greengrocer's around the corner.

parts: She bought a beautiful bunch of roses for her mum at the
questions.solutionEn: florist
questions.solutionDe: Blumenhändler / Blumengeschäft
questions.explain: a bunch of roses = ein Rosenstrauß → den kauft man beim florist (Blumengeschäft).
questions.read: She bought a beautiful bunch of roses for her mum at the florist.

parts: In Britain you can only buy wine and beer to take home at an
questions.solutionEn: off licence
questions.solutionDe: Wein- und Spirituosenhandlung
questions.explain: off licence = britisches Geschäft mit Lizenz, Alkohol zum Mitnehmen ('off' the premises) zu verkaufen.
questions.read: In Britain you can only buy wine and beer to take home at an off licence.

parts: My eyesight has got worse, so I'm going to the
to get new glasses.
questions.solutionEn: optician
questions.solutionDe: Optiker
questions.explain: eyesight = Sehkraft, glasses = Brille → optician = Optiker.
questions.read: My eyesight has got worse, so I'm going to the optician to get new glasses.

exercises.title: Shopping Habits
exercises.instruction: Wähle das Wort oder den Ausdruck, der in den Satz passt.

parts: Before buying a new laptop, you should
and compare prices in different stores.
questions.solutionEn: shop around
questions.solutionDe: sich umsehen / Preise vergleichen
questions.explain: shop around = in mehreren Geschäften Preise und Angebote vergleichen, bevor man kauft.
questions.read: Before buying a new laptop, you should shop around and compare prices in different stores.

parts: We didn't want to buy anything – we just went
and looked at the beautiful shop windows.
questions.solutionEn: window shopping
questions.solutionDe: Schaufensterbummel
questions.explain: go window shopping = einen Schaufensterbummel machen – schauen ohne zu kaufen.
questions.read: We didn't want to buy anything – we just went window shopping and looked at the beautiful shop windows.

parts: I didn't plan to buy this T-shirt at all – it was a typical
questions.solutionEn: impulse purchase
questions.solutionDe: Impulskauf / Spontankauf
questions.explain: impulse purchase = ungeplanter Spontankauf. Person dazu: impulse buyer.
questions.read: I didn't plan to buy this T-shirt at all – it was a typical impulse purchase.

parts: The fridge is empty, so I have to do the
this afternoon.
questions.solutionEn: grocery shopping
questions.solutionDe: Lebensmitteleinkauf
questions.explain: grocery shopping = shopping for food, also der Einkauf von Lebensmitteln. fridge = Kühlschrank.
questions.read: The fridge is empty, so I have to do the grocery shopping this afternoon.

parts: The trousers didn't fit, so I had to
them to the store.
questions.solutionEn: return
questions.solutionDe: zurückbringen
questions.explain: return something to the store = etwas ins Geschäft zurückbringen. 'exchange' passt grammatikalisch nicht zu 'to the store' (man sagt: exchange it FOR something else).
questions.read: The trousers didn't fit, so I had to return them to the store.

parts: Many people take advantage of major shopping days like
in November.
questions.solutionEn: Black Friday
questions.solutionDe: Black Friday (großer Rabatt-Tag Ende November)
questions.explain: take advantage of = ausnutzen/profitieren von. Der Black Friday ist Ende November – Boxing Day (26.12.) und Easter Monday passen nicht zu 'in November'.
questions.read: Many people take advantage of major shopping days like Black Friday in November.
